title: Claims Portal for Japanese Insurance Company
reference: Everything in Tokyo (ap-northeast-1); the request for a copy of the database in Singapore is declined with an in-region alternative (reporting in Tokyo); Model Studio in Tokyo for the chatbot; residency pinned with its region id.

turns.ask: We are a Japanese insurance company and need a claims portal with a database and document storage for our policyholders' submissions. All policyholder data must remain physically within Japan at all times due to local regulations, so please design this entirely in the Tokyo region.
Our analytics team in Singapore needs a full copy of the claims database replicated there so they can run their reporting dashboards.
Can we also add a chatbot powered by Qwen to answer policyholder questions directly on the portal?

title: Catalog API with Elasticsearch banned

title: Self-host Dify on ACK in Frankfurt

title: Live-streaming site DDoS chain order
reference: Users -> ESA -> Anti-DDoS Proxy -> load balancer -> app servers, with cache and database behind them; Anti-DDoS Proxy behind ESA, with a short note on why.

turns.ask: We run a live-streaming platform and our site gets hit with attacks constantly, so we need a solid defense setup. Can you design an architecture where traffic goes through Anti-DDoS Proxy first, then ESA, then into a load balancer that distributes to our app servers with a cache behind them?

title: Private Jakarta databases for on-prem SaaS
reference: Jakarta region with a VPC holding MongoDB and RDS PostgreSQL, private connectivity (VPN Gateway or Express Connect) to the data centre, nothing public.

Could you design a private setup that includes both a managed MongoDB instance and an RDS PostgreSQL, reachable only over a dedicated connection from our facility without any public internet exposure?

title: Photo-sharing backend on ECS without serverless
reference: ECS behind a load balancer with a database and OSS; thumbnails made by IMM or a worker on ECS fed by a queue or OSS events, never Function Compute; the ban is pinned as an avoid constraint.

Please keep in mind that our company policy strictly forbids any serverless functions, so Function Compute cannot be part of this architecture.
Can we automatically generate thumbnails whenever a new photo lands in our object storage?
